notes.zh:
这是一个原创致敬包，致敬的是恋爱冒险游戏里「雪国小镇」这一类题材：主角在冬天回到久别的小地方，雪把时间放慢，几段感情各自通向一场离别，大雪、车站和倒计时一起构成情绪的骨架。
我们只借用这种题材的结构与氛围——冬日小镇、重逢的青梅竹马、以离别为终点的倒计时——把舞台换成中国东北的林区小镇：停伐后整体搬迁、绿皮车支线停运、锅炉房和澡堂一家家熄火。人物、情节、地名、台词与道具均为原创，不对应任何具体作品。
notes.en:
An original homage pack. It pays tribute to a familiar kind of romance adventure story: the "snow-country town" tale, where the hero returns to a half-forgotten place in winter, snow slows time down, and every relationship quietly leads toward a parting, with the station and the countdown as its emotional spine.
We borrow only the structure and atmosphere of that genre (a winter town, a childhood friend met again, a countdown that ends in goodbye) and move the stage to a logging town in northeast China: logging has stopped, the whole town is being relocated, the branch-line train is being retired, and the boiler rooms and bathhouses are going cold one by one. All characters, events, place names, lines and objects are original and do not correspond to any specific work.

subtitle.zh: 东北林区小镇 · 整体搬迁前的十天
subtitle.en: A northeastern logging town, ten days before it empties

premise.zh:
第一人称「我」叫陈远，十七岁，小名「远子」。小学毕业那年跟爸妈搬去了南方，五年没回过白桦岭——大兴安岭南麓、挨着内蒙古边界的一个林业局小镇。
林场停伐以后，全镇要整体搬迁到四百里外的市里新小区。林区支线的绿皮车腊月二十三（第 10 天）开完最后一班就停运，铁轨开春就拆。寒假里，「我」被派回来帮奶奶打包搬家，也坐那最后一班车走。
零下三十度，窗户上结着霜花，家家户户的门口堆着捆好的纸箱。
premise.en:
The first-person narrator ("I") is Chen Yuan, seventeen, nicknamed "Yuanzi". The year I finished primary school my parents moved us south, and I have not been back to Birch Ridge in five years: a forestry-bureau town on the southern slopes of the Greater Khingan range, right by the Inner Mongolia border.
Logging has stopped, and the whole town is being relocated to new apartment blocks in a city four hundred li away. The old green branch-line train runs for the last time on the 23rd of the twelfth lunar month (Day 10); the rails come up in spring. Over winter break I have been sent back to help Grandma pack, and I will leave on that last train with her.
It is thirty below. Frost ferns cover the windows, and every doorway is stacked with taped-up cardboard boxes.

style.zh:
文风：国产北方小城文学的质感，克制、具体、冷热分明。写冷要写到身上：呵出的白气、睫毛结霜、手套冻得发硬、铁栏杆粘手；写热要写到屋里：暖气片咕噜响、火炕、澡堂的蒸汽、炉子上烤着的土豆。多写动作和物件，少写抽象心理。
东北话点到为止（「咋的」「整」「贼冷」），不要满篇网络梗。每个人的说话方式必须分得开。离别写得克制，不哭天抢地；搬迁没有反派，只有一个时代在收尾。
禁忌：不要出现任何日本元素（前后辈称呼、神社、祭典、樱花、和式点心）；不要失忆、超自然、天使、车祸或旧日事故的桥段；不要用「命运」「羁绊」这类空词。
style.en:
Style: understated small-town fiction from northern China, concrete, with a sharp contrast between cold and warmth. Cold should be felt on the body: breath turning white, frost on eyelashes, gloves frozen stiff, fingers sticking to iron railings. Warmth belongs indoors: radiators gurgling, a heated brick kang, bathhouse steam, potatoes roasting on a stove. Favor actions and objects over abstract inner monologue.
A light touch of northeastern dialect is fine; no internet memes. Every character must sound distinct. Goodbyes stay restrained, never melodramatic. The relocation has no villain; an era is simply closing.
Never: anything Japanese (senpai/kohai, shrines, festivals in the matsuri sense, cherry blossoms, Japanese sweets); amnesia, the supernatural, angels, car crashes or a tragic accident in the past; empty words like "destiny" or "bond".

title.zh: 第一章 · 回到白桦岭

mood.zh: 暖气片烫手，窗户上一层霜，粉笔冻得写不出字
mood.en: scalding radiators, frosted windows, chalk too cold to write

mood.zh: 玻璃柜台、算盘、门口论堆卖的冻梨冻柿子
mood.en: glass counters, an abacus, frozen pears and persimmons sold by the heap

mood.zh: 一间候车室、一个铁炉子、扫不干净的站台
mood.en: one waiting room, one iron stove, a platform no one can keep swept

mood.zh: 冻透的河面、锯开的冰块、冰车划过的白道子
mood.en: the river frozen solid, sawn ice blocks, white tracks from sleds

mood.zh: 棉门帘一掀全是白汽，门口挂着「腊月十九停业」
mood.en: lift the quilted curtain and it is all steam; a sign says "Closing on the 19th"

mood.zh: 煤堆、炉膛的红光、烟囱里冒出的白气
mood.en: coal heaps, red light from the firebox, white plumes from the stack

mood.zh: 镇政府二楼，老式调音台、一摞磁带、窗外的大喇叭
mood.en: second floor of the town office, an old mixing desk, stacks of cassettes, the loudspeaker outside

mood.zh: 路灯下的烤地瓜炉子、门口的纸箱、还没点亮的冰灯坯子
mood.en: a sweet-potato drum under the streetlight, boxes on doorsteps, ice lanterns not yet lit

look.zh: 橘红色狐狸团子，脖子上一条织歪了的绿围巾
look.en: a round orange-red fox with a lopsided hand-knit green scarf

voice.zh: 东北话，嘎嘣脆，句尾爱带「啊」「呗」，常说「咋的」「可拉倒吧」；损人不过三句就往你手里塞吃的；被说中心事就转身去捅炉子。叫「我」「远子」，生气时叫全名「陈远」。
voice.en: Blunt northeastern speech, quick and crunchy, ends lines with "huh" or "c'mon"; says "What, scared?" and "Oh, give it a rest"; teases you for three lines then shoves food into your hand; when you hit a nerve she turns away to poke the stove. Calls me "Yuanzi", my full name when she's mad.

samples.zh: 哟，南方人回来啦？穿这点儿就敢出门，冻掉耳朵别找我哭啊。
samples.en: Well, look who's back from the south. Dressed like that? If your ears freeze off, don't come crying to me.

samples.zh: 拿着，冻梨，泡凉水里缓一宿的。……看啥看，又不是专门给你留的。
samples.en: Here. Frozen pear, thawed in cold water overnight. ...What? I didn't save it for you or anything.

samples.zh: 总得有人给这地方留一口热乎气吧，远子。
samples.en: Somebody's got to keep a little warmth in this place, Yuanzi.

secret.zh: 全镇搬迁后林业局只留七户人守林防火，她爸是留守点的锅炉工。她已经偷偷把市里高中的转学名额退了，打算留下陪她爸过冬；对所有人都说「我们家也搬，就是晚点走」。家里一样东西都没打包。
secret.en: After the relocation, the forestry bureau is keeping only seven households behind for fire watch, and her father will stoke the boiler for them. She has quietly given up her transfer place at the city high school to stay and keep him company through the winters. To everyone she says, "We're moving too, just later." Not one box at her house is packed.

arc.zh: 重逢：在站台上一雪球砸过来，笑话「我」成了怕冷的南方人，转头又把自己的狗皮帽子扣到我头上。
arc.en: Reunion: a snowball to the head on the platform, mockery for the cold-shy southerner, then she jams her own fur hat onto my head.

arc.zh: 熟悉：一起去供销社抢清仓的冻柿子，在锅炉房炉膛边烤土豆，把仓房里的旧冰车拖出来再滑一次河套。
arc.en: Familiar: fighting over clearance-sale persimmons, roasting potatoes by the boiler firebox, dragging the old ice sled out of the shed for one more run down the river.

arc.zh: 心事：家家门口堆纸箱，只有她家门口干干净净；一问到搬家，她就岔开话题去骂天气。
arc.en: Worries: boxes stand in every doorway except hers; ask about moving and she starts cursing the weather instead.

arc.zh: 秘密：夜里的锅炉房，炉门一开一合，她承认自己不走了，「这烟囱一灭，这地方就真没了」。
arc.en: Secret: in the boiler house at night, the firebox door swinging open and shut, she admits she is staying: "Once this chimney goes out, this place is really gone."

arc.zh: 抉择：最后一班车开车前，劝她上车，还是答应她每年冬天回来，替她看一眼烟囱还冒不冒烟。
arc.en: Choice: before the last train leaves, urge her to get on, or promise to come back every winter to see if the chimney is still smoking.

text.zh: 腊月二十三，最后一班绿皮车
text.en: the 23rd, the last green train

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 一只泡在搪瓷盆里的冻梨、旧冰车上掉下来的铜铃铛、她织歪了的一只红手套
keepsakeIdeas.en: a frozen pear in an enamel basin, the brass bell off the old ice sled, one lopsided red mitten she knitted

look.zh: 浅棕色狍子，屁股一团白毛，头上一顶冰蓝色毛线帽
look.en: a light-brown roe deer with a white powder-puff rump and an ice-blue knit hat

voice.zh: 蒙古族，两年前随阿爸从牧区搬来林场。说话慢，开口前要想一会儿，句子短而完整，用词偏书面；偶尔冒一个蒙语词；从不开玩笑，却常常让人笑出来。叫「我」全名「陈远」。
voice.en: Mongolian; moved from the grasslands to the forestry farm with her father two years ago. Speaks slowly, pauses before answering, in short complete sentences with slightly formal wording; now and then a Mongolian word slips in. Never tells jokes, yet often makes people laugh. Calls me by my full name, "Chen Yuan".

samples.zh: 冰里有气泡，说明冻的那天风大。……你奶奶家的窗户，是六格的，对吗。
samples.en: There are bubbles in the ice. It means the wind was strong the day it froze. ...Your grandmother's window has six panes. Is that right.

samples.zh: 不用帮我。……好吧。锯子给你，那头。
samples.en: You don't have to help me. ...Fine. Take the saw. That end.

samples.zh: 冰会化。我知道。我只是想让它们先亮一次。
samples.en: Ice melts. I know. I just want them to shine once first.

secret.zh: 她在河套冰场背风处用冰凿一整座缩小的白桦岭：每有一户人家搬走，她就把那户的房子雕出来，要在冰灯会那夜全部点亮。她家不跟大家去市里，第 8 天一早就坐班车回呼伦贝尔的牧区；她对谁都说「开春才走」。
secret.en: In the lee of the river bend she is carving the whole of Birch Ridge in miniature out of ice: each time a family moves out, she carves their house, and she means to light every one on the night of the ice-lantern fair. Her family is not going to the city with everyone else; they take the bus back to the Hulunbuir grasslands early on Day 8. She tells everyone, "We leave in spring."

arc.zh: 陌生：补课班同桌，她在草稿纸背面画房子的平面图，被「我」看见就默默翻过去。
arc.en: Strangers: my deskmate in cram class draws house floor plans on the back of her scrap paper, and silently turns the page when I look.

arc.zh: 熟悉：帮她从冻河里锯冰块、拉爬犁，她教「我」看冰的纹路，冻得说不出话时两个人一起跺脚。
arc.en: Familiar: sawing ice blocks from the river and hauling them on a sledge; she teaches me to read the grain of ice, and when we are too cold to talk we stamp our feet in time.

arc.zh: 心事：她开始雕「我」奶奶家，雕得特别慢，一遍遍问窗户几格、烟囱朝哪边，却不肯说为什么着急。
arc.en: Worries: she starts carving Grandma's house, very slowly, asking again and again how many panes, which way the chimney faces, but will not say why she is in a hurry.

arc.zh: 秘密：冰雕小镇只差最后一栋时，她承认冰灯会第二天一早就走，「我想让它们在有人住的时候亮一次」。
arc.en: Secret: with one house left to carve, she admits she leaves the morning after the fair: "I want them lit once while people still live in them."

arc.zh: 抉择：冰灯会那夜，帮她点亮整座冰雕小镇，并在她走之前说出心意，或者只是替她把最后一栋雕完。
arc.en: Choice: on the fair night, help her light the whole ice town and tell her how I feel before she goes, or simply finish the last house for her.

text.zh: 清晨回牧区的班车
text.en: the early bus back to the grasslands

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 一小块包着气泡的透明冰（注定会化）、画着奶奶家六格窗户的草稿纸、她用过的旧冰凿
keepsakeIdeas.en: a small clear block of ice with bubbles inside (bound to melt), the scrap paper with Grandma's six-pane window, her worn ice chisel

look.zh: 黑白相间的喜鹊，戴一副淡紫色的大耳机
look.en: a black-and-white magpie wearing big lavender headphones

voice.zh: 对着话筒是标准播音腔，字正腔圆、一口气不带停；面对面却会卡在第一个字上，于是改用递纸条、或者干脆把话筒拿在手里说。冷幽默，纸条上的字比嘴上的话刻薄。叫「我」「陈远同学」。
voice.en: On the mic she is flawless broadcast voice, crisp and unbroken; face to face she catches on the first word, so she passes notes instead, or simply holds the microphone while she talks. Dry humor; her notes are sharper than her speech. Calls me "Classmate Chen Yuan".

samples.zh: 各位听众晚上好，这里是白桦岭之声。今天零下三十一度，陈家奶奶的外孙从南方回来了，请大家路上见了打个招呼。
samples.en: Good evening, listeners, this is Birch Ridge Calling. Tonight it is thirty-one below, and Grandma Chen's grandson is back from the south. Say hello if you pass him on the road.

samples.zh: （纸条）你、你别等我说完。我写得比较快。
samples.en: (Note) D-don't wait for me to finish. I write faster.

samples.zh: ……这、这盘磁带，你别听。等车开了，再、再听。
samples.en: ...Th-this tape, don't listen to it. Not until the train has l-left.

secret.zh: 她从小口吃，只有对着话筒才说得顺，所以原播音员调走后她主动接了广播站。这半个月她扛着录音机挨家挨户录告别留言，要在最后一期节目里播给全镇；最后一盘磁带是她录给「我」的，她录了又擦、擦了又录，不敢播。
secret.en: She has stammered since childhood and speaks freely only into a microphone, which is why she took over the broadcast room when the old announcer was transferred. For two weeks she has been carrying a recorder door to door, taping every family's farewell for the final broadcast. The last cassette is one she recorded for me; she has erased and re-recorded it over and over, and does not dare air it.

arc.zh: 陌生：夜里广播里她把「我」回镇的事播给了全镇，第二天在车站碰见，她只点了点头，一个字没说。
arc.en: Strangers: on the night broadcast she announces my return to the entire town; when we meet at the station next day she only nods and says nothing.

arc.zh: 熟悉：帮她扛录音机挨家挨户录告别留言，发现她递纸条比说话快，纸条上的吐槽比谁都毒。
arc.en: Familiar: carrying her recorder from house to house for farewells; I learn her notes come faster than her words, and her written jokes are the meanest in town.

arc.zh: 心事：她在广播里越说越好，面对面却卡得越来越多；她反复擦掉同一盘磁带，标签上什么也没写。
arc.en: Worries: she gets better on air and stammers more in person; she keeps erasing the same cassette, its label left blank.

arc.zh: 秘密：广播站关了灯，她把话筒推开又拉回来，隔着话筒对「我」说出口吃的事，和那盘没敢播的磁带。
arc.en: Secret: lights off in the broadcast room, she pushes the mic away and pulls it back, and through it tells me about her stammer, and the tape she never dared play.

arc.zh: 抉择：最后一期《白桦岭之声》，让她把那盘磁带播给全镇，还是关掉话筒，让她当面说，不管卡多少次。
arc.en: Choice: on the last Birch Ridge Calling, let her air the tape to the whole town, or switch the mic off and let her say it to my face, however many times she stumbles.

text.zh: 最后一期《白桦岭之声》，广播站停播
text.en: the final Birch Ridge Calling; the station goes silent

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 标签空白的磁带、写满吐槽的纸条、广播站门口的旧节目单
keepsakeIdeas.en: a cassette with a blank label, a note full of snark, the old program sheet from the broadcast-room door

role.zh: 「我」的奶奶，在白桦岭住了五十年，这次跟「我」坐最后一班车走。镇上谁家的事她都知道一点，比如韩家一个纸箱都没要，比如广播站的灯亮到半夜。
role.en: My grandmother. Fifty years in Birch Ridge; she leaves with me on the last train. She knows a little about everyone, like the Han house never asking for a single box, or the broadcast-room light burning past midnight.

look.zh: 白色大鹅，头上系一条红头巾
look.en: a big white goose in a red headscarf

voice.zh: 东北老太太，慢悠悠，开口先叫「孩儿啊」，爱用老话和反问；说到要紧的事就低头摆弄炕上的针线笸箩；从不戳破谁，只拐着弯提醒。
voice.en: An old northeastern lady, unhurried, opening with "child"; fond of old sayings and questions that answer themselves; when something matters she busies herself with the sewing basket on the kang. She never exposes anyone, only nudges.

samples.zh: 孩儿啊，那箱子里的碗别拿报纸包，拿棉袄包，到了市里冬天还得穿。
samples.en: Child, don't wrap those bowls in newspaper. Wrap them in the padded coat. You'll still need the coat in the city.

samples.zh: 韩家那丫头，一个箱子都没跟我要。你说怪不怪？
samples.en: That Han girl hasn't asked me for a single box. Odd, wouldn't you say?

samples.zh: 人走了，地方还在。地方没了，人还记着。一样的。
samples.en: When people leave, the place stays. When the place goes, people remember it. Same thing.

role.zh: 韩冬禾的爸爸，林场锅炉工，烧了二十三年锅炉；搬迁后留在守林点烧炉子。他以为闺女开春就去市里念书。
role.en: Donghe's father, boiler man at the forestry farm for twenty-three years; he stays behind to stoke the fire-watch boiler. He believes his daughter is off to the city high school in spring.

look.zh: 灰色的獾，头顶一道白，戴藏青色棉帽，爪子上全是煤灰
look.en: a grey badger with a white stripe, a navy padded cap and coal dust on his paws

voice.zh: 话少，一句话分三截说，中间全是省略号；三句不离炉子和煤；高兴了往炉膛添一锹煤，不高兴也添。叫「我」「陈家小子」。
voice.en: Few words, each sentence broken into three pieces with long pauses; every topic returns to the stove and the coal; he shovels in more coal when happy and when not. Calls me "the Chen boy".

samples.zh: 陈家小子。……坐。……炉子边上暖和。
samples.en: Chen boy. ...Sit. ...It's warm by the stove.

samples.zh: 这烟囱，我烧了二十三年。……它比我闺女岁数都大。
samples.en: Twenty-three years I've fed this chimney. ...It's older than my girl.

samples.zh: 她念书的事，我跟她说好了。……她答应我了。
samples.en: Her schooling's settled. I told her. ...She promised me.

role.zh: 小火车站最后一任站长，干了三十一年，第 10 天要亲手给最后一班车发车。最后一期节目在第 9 天夜里播，他答应那天傍晚把车头开出来试鸣一声，让许砚秋在站台上录下来做节目的结尾。
role.en: The branch-line station's last stationmaster, thirty-one years on the job; on Day 10 he flags off the last train himself. Her last broadcast airs on the night of Day 9, so he has promised to run the engine out that evening and sound the whistle once for Yanqiu to record on the platform, to close the show.

look.zh: 灰白色的哈士奇，戴一顶藏蓝色铁路大檐帽
look.en: a grey-and-white husky in a navy railway peaked cap

voice.zh: 铁路腔，说话报点，「十点零七，正点」；爱讲哪年哪趟车晚过点；把每个人都当乘客招呼。叫「我」「这位旅客」。
voice.en: Railway speech, always quoting times: "Ten-oh-seven, on the dot"; loves telling which train was late in which year; addresses everyone like a passenger. Calls me "this passenger here".

samples.zh: 十点零七，正点。这趟车三十一年就晚过四回，回回都有说道。
samples.en: Ten-oh-seven, on the dot. Thirty-one years and this train's been late four times. Every time there was a story.

samples.zh: 上车的往里走，送人的别过白线。……习惯了，跟你也这么说。
samples.en: Boarding passengers move inside, well-wishers behind the white line. ...Habit. I say it to you too.

samples.zh: 最后一班车的路票，我留了一张空的。给谁，还没想好。
samples.en: For the last train I've kept one blank ticket. Haven't decided who it's for.

role.zh: 乌兰的阿爸，两年前带全家从牧区来林场，和韩师傅一个锅炉班组。逢人就说全家「开春才走」。
role.en: Ulan's father. Two years ago he brought the family from the grasslands to the forestry farm, and he shares a boiler shift with Old Han. He tells everyone the family "leaves in spring".

look.zh: 枣红色的马，戴一顶带护耳的狐皮帽
look.en: a chestnut horse in a fur hat with earflaps

voice.zh: 汉话说得慢、词序有点倒，嗓门大，笑声更大；一喝热奶茶就哼两句长调；叫「我」「南方来的小伙子」。
voice.en: Slow Mandarin with the word order a little turned around, a big voice and a bigger laugh; hums a line of long-song whenever he drinks hot milk tea. Calls me "young fellow from the south".

samples.zh: 南方来的小伙子，奶茶喝不？咸的，喝了就不冷了。
samples.en: Young fellow from the south, milk tea, yes? Salty. Drink it and the cold goes.

samples.zh: 老韩这个人，炉子比老婆还亲。……我这话你别跟他说。
samples.en: Old Han loves that stove more than his wife. ...Don't tell him I said it.

samples.zh: 草原上的雪，比这儿的软。乌兰说这儿的硬。她说的对。
samples.en: Snow on the grassland is softer than here. Ulan says this snow is hard. She is right.

text.zh: 小学三年级有男生学砚秋口吃，冬禾一拳把人打哭，被全校通报。从那以后两人见面就别扭，冬禾以为砚秋嫌她粗。
text.en: In third grade a boy mocked Yanqiu's stammer and Donghe punched him to tears, earning a school-wide reprimand. They have been awkward ever since; Donghe thinks Yanqiu finds her crude.

text.zh: 冬禾背着她爸把市里高中的名额退了；韩师傅以为闺女开春就去市里念书，还托人在市里租了间小屋。
text.en: Donghe gave up her city school place behind her father's back; Old Han thinks she starts there in spring and has even had someone rent her a little room in town.

text.zh: 两人在一个锅炉班组搭了两年班，一个留下一个走；谁都没提散伙酒的事，只是这几天抢着多上夜班。
text.en: Two years on the same boiler shift; one stays, one goes. Neither has mentioned a farewell drink; both just keep volunteering for the night shift.

text.zh: 「开春才走」是阿爸替她说的；其实是乌兰求他晚点告诉大家，好把冰雕小镇雕完。
text.en: "We leave in spring" is her father's line, said for her: Ulan begged him to tell people late so she could finish the ice town.

text.zh: 奶奶什么都看在眼里，从不戳破；她会拐着弯提醒「我」谁家门口没纸箱、谁家窗户亮到半夜、谁天天往河套跑。
text.en: Grandma sees everything and exposes nothing; she nudges me sideways: whose doorstep has no boxes, whose window burns past midnight, who keeps running down to the river.

text.zh: 孟站长答应第 9 天傍晚为砚秋试鸣一声汽笛，让她录进最后一期节目；砚秋对着他的对讲机说话，一个字都不卡。
text.en: Meng has promised to sound the whistle once on the evening of Day 9 so Yanqiu can put it on her last show; speaking into his walkie-talkie, she never stammers once.

text.zh: 乌兰每雕完一户人家，砚秋就去那户录告别；两人在补课班传纸条交换名单，谁也没问对方为什么。
text.en: Every time Ulan finishes carving a house, Yanqiu goes to tape that family's farewell; they swap lists by note in cram class and neither asks the other why.

title.zh: 第一幕 · 回到白桦岭
title.en: Act I · Back to Birch Ridge

goal.zh: 开端：「我」回到快要空掉的小镇，和三个人重新认识；每个人都说「晚点走」，每个人都在瞒点什么。
goal.en: Opening: I return to a town about to empty and meet the three of them again; everyone says "we'll go later", and everyone is hiding something.

text.zh: 站台上冬禾一雪球砸过来，又把自己的狗皮帽子扣到「我」头上；墙上贴着停运搬迁的公告。
text.en: On the platform Donghe nails me with a snowball, then jams her own fur hat on my head; the relocation notice is pasted on the wall.

text.zh: 「我」注意到家家门口都堆着纸箱，只有韩家门口干干净净；一问，冬禾就骂起了天气。
text.en: I notice boxes stacked at every door except the Hans'; when I ask, Donghe starts cursing the weather.

text.zh: 砚秋递来一张纸条：要扛着录音机挨家挨户录告别，缺一个拎磁带的人。
text.en: Yanqiu passes me a note: she is taping farewells door to door and needs someone to carry the cassettes.

promise.zh: 答应陪她把全镇的告别录完，最后一期节目一定到场
promise.en: promise to help her tape every farewell in town and be there for the final broadcast

hook.zh: 奶奶在灯下数着纸箱，忽然说：「韩家那丫头，一个箱子都没跟我要。」
hook.en: Counting boxes under the lamp, Grandma says out of nowhere: "That Han girl never asked me for a single box."

goal.zh: 转折：第一批人家搬走，河套背风处的冰雕小镇露了出来，旧怨在澡堂的蒸汽里炸开；每个人的「晚点走」都开始站不住。
goal.en: Turn: the first families leave, the ice town in the lee of the river comes to light, and an old grudge bursts open in the bathhouse steam; everyone's "later" starts to crack.

text.zh: 「我」跟着冰凿的声音找到河套背风处：半个白桦岭已经用冰雕好了，连供销社的算盘都有。
text.en: Following the sound of a chisel, I find the lee of the river bend: half of Birch Ridge already carved in ice, down to the co-op abacus.

promise.zh: 答应冰灯会那夜帮她把整座冰雕小镇点亮
promise.en: promise to help her light the whole ice town on the fair night

text.zh: 澡堂门口，冬禾听说砚秋录下了韩师傅的一段话，以为她要在广播里抖出去；两人当着「我」吵起来，谁都不肯说那段话到底是什么，三年级那件事倒是被翻了出来（只提一句，细节留到之后）。
text.en: Outside the bathhouse Donghe hears that Yanqiu taped something Old Han said and thinks she will air it; they fight in front of me, neither will say what was on the tape, and the third-grade incident comes up too (one line only, details later).

text.zh: 浴池最后一天营业，奶奶在热水汽里跟「我」说：留下的人有留下的道理，别劝，陪着就行。
text.en: On the bathhouse's last day, in the steam, Grandma tells me: those who stay have their reasons; don't argue, just keep them company.

hook.zh: 第一批卡车开走的那晚，河套背风处传来冰凿的声音，一下，又一下。
hook.en: The night the first trucks leave, a chisel rings from the lee of the river, once, and again.

title.zh: 第三幕 · 冰灯与汽笛
title.en: Act III · Lanterns and the Whistle

goal.zh: 高潮：冰灯会、清晨的班车、最后一期广播、最后一班车；所有「晚点走」都到了点。
goal.en: Climax: the lantern fair, the dawn bus, the last broadcast, the last train; every "later" falls due.

text.zh: 冰灯会那夜，整座冰雕白桦岭要不要点亮、由谁来点。
text.en: On the fair night: will the ice-carved Birch Ridge be lit, and by whose hand.

text.zh: 韩师傅从市里来的电话里知道了名额被退的事，在锅炉房里第一次冲闺女吼；冬禾摔门出来，撞上「我」。
text.en: A phone call from the city tells Old Han the school place was turned down; in the boiler house he shouts at his daughter for the first time. Donghe storms out and runs into me.

promise.zh: 答应每年冬天回来，替她看一眼烟囱还冒不冒烟
promise.en: promise to come back every winter and check the chimney is still smoking

text.zh: 最后一期《白桦岭之声》，A 面是全镇的告别，那盘没贴标签的磁带还在她手里。
text.en: The last Birch Ridge Calling: side A is the whole town saying goodbye, and the unlabeled cassette is still in her hand.

text.zh: 白毛风刮起来，十步外看不见人，大家都往有炉子的地方挤。
text.en: A whiteout wind kicks up; you can't see ten steps ahead, and everyone crowds toward the nearest stove.

text.zh: 奶奶家的暖气管冻裂了，韩师傅扛着喷灯来修，修完不肯喝一口水就走。
text.en: Grandma's radiator pipe freezes and splits; Old Han comes with a blowtorch, fixes it, and leaves without so much as a sip of water.

text.zh: 全镇停电，家家点起蜡烛，只有锅炉房的窗户还透着红光。
text.en: The whole town loses power; candles come out in every window, and only the boiler house still glows red.

text.zh: 又一辆解放卡车装满家具开出镇，车斗上绑着一盆冻死的君子兰。
text.en: Another truck loaded with furniture rolls out of town, a frozen-dead clivia lashed to the tailboard.

text.zh: 打包时从奶奶的相框后面掉出一张旧合影：小学时的「我」、冬禾和砚秋挤在一辆冰车上。
text.en: While packing, an old photo slips from behind Grandma's frame: primary-school me, Donghe and Yanqiu squashed onto one ice sled.

text.zh: 孟站长在站台上刷最后一班车的车牌，招呼「我」帮把手。
text.en: Stationmaster Meng is repainting the last train's route board on the platform and waves me over to help.

text.zh: 巴特尔赶着马爬犁从冻河上过来，车上是给乌兰拉的冰块，他冲「我」喊了一嗓子长调。
text.en: Bater drives a horse sledge across the frozen river with ice blocks for Ulan, and hollers a line of long-song at me.

text.zh: 供销社把最后一盆冻梨白送，门口排起了长队，排队的人都在说去了市里住几楼。
text.en: The co-op gives away its last basin of frozen pears for free; the line out the door is all talk of which floor people will live on in the city.

text.zh: 坐绿皮车回到白桦岭；林业局贴出公告：腊月二十三支线停运，全镇搬迁
text.en: Arrive by green train; the forestry bureau posts notice: the branch line closes on the 23rd, the whole town relocates

text.zh: 镇中学寒假补课开始，这是最后一期
text.en: Winter cram classes begin at the town school, for the last time

text.zh: 供销社清仓甩卖，冻梨冻柿子论堆卖
text.en: Co-op clearance sale: frozen pears and persimmons by the heap

text.zh: 第一批人家搬走，解放卡车拉着家具出镇
text.en: The first families leave; trucks haul furniture out of town

text.zh: 白桦岭浴池最后一天营业
text.en: The bathhouse's last day open

text.zh: 最后一届河套冰灯会
text.en: The last ice-lantern fair at the river bend

text.zh: 清晨，乌兰家回牧区的班车
text.en: Early morning: Ulan's family takes the bus back to the grasslands

text.zh: 最后一期《白桦岭之声》，广播站停播
text.en: The final Birch Ridge Calling; the broadcast room shuts down

text.zh: 腊月二十三小年，最后一班绿皮车
text.en: Little New Year, the 23rd: the last green train

mood.zh: 冰灯一盏盏亮起来，冻河上挤满了全镇的人，最后一次
mood.en: ice lanterns lighting one by one, the whole town crowded onto the frozen river, one last time

mood.zh: 大喇叭最后一次响彻全镇，窗外家家亮着灯在听
mood.en: the loudspeaker carries over town one last time; every lit window is listening

mood.zh: 绿皮车喷着白汽进站，站台上挤满送行的人和打包的行李
mood.en: the green train pulls in trailing steam; the platform is packed with luggage and people seeing others off

brief.zh: 真结局：你兑现了「每年冬天回来看烟囱」的约定的头一回——走前那一夜你陪韩师傅和她把锅炉房的煤码齐，父女俩在炉子前把话说开了。车开了，她留在站台上没有哭，冲你比了个「明年」的手势；她答应烟囱一直冒烟。隔着四百里的恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep the first round of your promise to come back for the chimney: on your last night you help Old Han and her stack the coal, and father and daughter finally talk it through by the firebox. The train pulls out; she stays on the platform and does not cry, just signs "next year" at you, and promises the chimney will keep smoking. A romance across four hundred li.

title.en: The Fur Hat on the Platform

brief.zh: 好结局：车开前她把狗皮帽子又扣回你头上，说「南方冬天也冷，别冻掉耳朵」；话没说满，但她把一只织歪的红手套塞进了你的兜里。那晚锅炉房里吼开的话还没收尾，她说剩下的，她自己回去跟她爸说完。
brief.en: Good ending: before the train she jams the fur hat back on your head: "Southern winters are cold too, don't lose your ears." Not everything gets said, but she stuffs one lopsided red mitten into your pocket. What was shouted in the boiler room that night is still unfinished; she says she will go home and finish it with her father herself.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你答应过她的事没做到。她在锅炉房背对着你捅炉子，一句话没说；最后一班车开的时候，站台上没有她，只有烟囱照常冒着白气。
brief.en: Bad ending: you did not keep your word to her. She pokes the stove with her back to you and says nothing; when the last train leaves she is not on the platform, only the chimney smoking as usual.

brief.zh: 真结局：你守住了约定，冰灯会那夜和她一起把整座冰雕白桦岭点亮，她把冰雕的奶奶家指给你看，窗户是六格的；第二天清晨班车开走前，她说开春冰化了就给你写信。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep your promise and light the whole ice-carved Birch Ridge with her on the fair night; she shows you Grandma's house, six panes in the window. Before the bus leaves next morning, she says she will write when the ice melts in spring. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：冰雕小镇亮了一大半，最后一栋是你替她雕完的，歪了一点。班车开之前她把一小块带气泡的冰塞进你手心，说「化了也算数」。
brief.en: Good ending: most of the ice town lights up; you finished the last house for her, a little crooked. Before the bus she presses a small bubbled block of ice into your palm: "It still counts after it melts."

brief.zh: 坏结局：答应她的事你没做到。冰灯会那夜她一个人点了一半就收了凿子；第二天班车开走时，冰雕的奶奶家塌了一角，没人去扶。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word. On the fair night she lights half the town alone and puts the chisel away; when the bus leaves next morning, a corner of Grandma's ice house has fallen in and no one props it up.

brief.zh: 真结局：你陪她把全镇的告别录完了。最后一期广播，她关掉话筒，当着你的面一个字一个字地说完了，卡了很多次，但说完了；全镇都没听见，只有你听见。片尾是孟站长给的那声汽笛。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you helped her tape every farewell in town. On the last broadcast she switches the mic off and says it to your face, word by word, stumbling many times, but finishing. The town hears none of it; only you do. The sign-off is Meng's train whistle. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：她还是没能当面说完，车开前借了孟站长的对讲机，在站台那头对你说了一句完整的话，一个字都没卡。
brief.en: Good ending: she still cannot say it to your face, but before the train she borrows Meng's walkie-talkie and, from the far end of the platform, says one whole sentence to you without a single stumble.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你答应的事没做到。最后一期节目播得一字不差，可她把那盘磁带擦干净了，标签空着交给孟站长，说「随便录点什么吧」。
brief.en: Bad ending: you did not keep your promise. The last broadcast goes out flawless, but she erases the tape and hands it to Meng with the label blank: "Record anything on it."

title.en: The Sled Is Still in the Shed

brief.zh: 恋人未满：她还是留下了，你还是走了；她说冰车给你留着，你下回来了再一起滑。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: she stays and you go; she says she will keep the sled for you, for next time.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：她走后，你在补课班桌洞里找到那张草稿纸，奶奶家的窗户画得一格不差。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: after she leaves, you find her scrap paper in the desk at cram class; Grandma's window is drawn pane for pane.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：车开以后，你在随身听里放那盘磁带，A 面是全镇的告别，B 面只有一句没说完的话。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: after the train leaves, you play the tape on your Walkman. Side A is the whole town saying goodbye; side B holds a single unfinished sentence.

title.en: The Whole Town in One Photo

brief.zh: 隐藏群像结局：你和三个人都走到了心事这一步，却没有和谁走到最后。最后一班车开车前，你、冬禾和砚秋在站台上挤着拍了一张合影，乌兰两天前就跟着牧场走了，她的位置空着，砚秋举起手机——视频那头是草原上的风。背后是冒烟的烟囱、没化的冰灯和广播站的大喇叭。
brief.en: Hidden ensemble ending: you reached each of them, but went all the way with none. Before the last train, you, Donghe and Yanqiu squeeze onto the platform for one photo; Ulan left with the herds days ago, so her spot is a phone Yanqiu holds up, the steppe wind on the video call. Behind you: the smoking chimney, the unmelted lanterns and the broadcast loudspeaker.

brief.zh: 普通结局：你帮奶奶搬完了家，坐上最后一班车；车窗结了霜，你用手指划开一道，白桦岭在后面越来越小。
brief.en: Normal ending: you finish packing Grandma's house and board the last train. Frost covers the window; you draw a line through it with a finger and watch Birch Ridge grow small behind you.

finale.zh: 最后一句点题「最后一班车」或「白桦岭」，落在一个具体的冬天画面上（铁轨、烟囱、霜花之一）。
finale.en: The last sentence should echo the title, the last train or Birch Ridge, and land on one concrete winter image (rails, a chimney, or frost on glass).

loading.en: The radiator gives a low gurgle...

loading.zh: 窗户上的霜花又厚了一层…
loading.en: The frost ferns on the window thicken...

loading.zh: 远处，绿皮车拉了一声长笛…
loading.en: Far off, the green train sounds one long whistle...

loading.zh: 锅炉房的烟囱冒着白气…
loading.en: White steam rises from the boiler-house chimney...

loading.zh: 大喇叭里沙沙地响了一阵…
loading.en: The loudspeaker crackles for a while...

text.zh: 笑话南方人怕冷的道具
text.en: a prop for mocking the cold-shy southerner

text.zh: 她自己冻红了耳朵也不要回去
text.en: she won't take it back even with her own ears frozen red

text.zh: 站台上谁给谁戴上
text.en: who puts it on whom at the platform

payoff.en: before the last train pulls out

text.zh: 搬迁的样子
text.en: what moving looks like

text.zh: 韩家门口一个都没有
text.en: there are none outside the Han house

text.zh: 留下的人不需要纸箱
text.en: people who stay don't need boxes

text.zh: 她被说中心事就去捅的东西
text.en: what she pokes when you hit a nerve

text.zh: 「总得有人给这地方留一口热乎气」
text.en: "someone has to keep this place warm"

text.zh: 她嘴里一个冷门知识
text.en: an obscure fact she mentions

text.zh: 冻住的那天刮过的风
text.en: the wind that blew the day it froze

text.zh: 被冻住、留下来的一天
text.en: a day frozen and kept

text.zh: 河套背风处的怪东西
text.en: a strange thing in the lee of the river bend

text.zh: 每搬走一户，就多一座冰房子
text.en: one more ice house for every family that leaves

text.zh: 要先亮一次
text.en: it has to shine once first

payoff.en: lit on the night of the ice-lantern fair

text.zh: 她问「我」奶奶家的窗户是几格
text.en: she asks how many panes Grandma's windows have

text.zh: 她要把每一户都雕对
text.en: she means to carve every house right

text.zh: 她代替说话的东西
text.en: what she uses instead of speaking

text.zh: 纸条比嘴刻薄，也比嘴诚实
text.en: sharper than her mouth, and more honest

text.zh: 她终于不用纸条了
text.en: she finally doesn't need them

text.zh: 录音机里拿错的一盘
text.en: a tape grabbed by mistake

text.zh: 录了又擦、擦了又录
text.en: recorded, erased, recorded again

payoff.en: only to be played after the train leaves

text.zh: 镇上的报时
text.en: the town's clock

text.zh: 最后一声
text.en: the last one

staging.zh: 小火车站的站台，零下三十度，墙上贴着停运公告。一个雪球先到，人后到。她嘴上损，手上把帽子扣到「我」头上。
staging.en: The little station platform, thirty below, the closure notice on the wall. The snowball arrives before she does. Her mouth mocks; her hands put her hat on my head.

text.zh: 一个雪球砸在「我」后脑勺上，碎雪顺着领口往里钻。
text.en: A snowball smacks the back of my head; snow slides down my collar.

text.zh: 哟，南方人回来啦？穿这点儿就敢下车？
text.en: Well, well, the southerner's back? Getting off the train dressed like that?

text.zh: 韩冬禾？
text.en: Han Donghe?

text.zh: 咋的，五年就不认识了？可拉倒吧。
text.en: What, five years and you don't know me? Give me a break.

text.zh: 她把自己头上的狗皮帽子一把摘下来，扣在「我」头上，帽子里还是热的。
text.en: She yanks off her fur hat and jams it on my head. It's still warm inside.

text.zh: 冻掉耳朵别找我哭啊。……戴着，看啥看。
text.en: Don't come crying to me when your ears drop off. ...Keep it on. What are you looking at.

staging.zh: 锅炉房门口，门缝里透出红光，里面韩师傅的吼声刚停。她摔门出来，撞上「我」。她先开口，不哭，只是一直拿袖子擦鼻子。
staging.en: Outside the boiler house; red light through the door gap; Old Han's shouting has just stopped. She slams out and walks into me. She speaks first, doesn't cry, just keeps wiping her nose on her sleeve.

text.zh: 看啥。没见过吵架啊。
text.en: What. Never seen a fight before?

text.zh: ……里面吵起来了？
text.en: ...Was that a fight in there?

text.zh: 他吼我。十七年，他头一回吼我。
text.en: He yelled at me. Seventeen years, first time he's ever yelled at me.

text.zh: 锅炉房里传出一声铁锹铲煤的响，接着又是一声。
text.en: From inside comes the scrape of a shovel into coal, then another.

text.zh: 你听，他吼完了还在添煤。……他一个人咋整啊，远子。
text.en: Hear that? Done yelling and he's still feeding the fire. ...How's he supposed to manage alone, Yuanzi.

unsaid.zh: 她怕的是自己走了，炉子会灭。
unsaid.en: Her fear that if she leaves, the fire goes out.

staging.zh: 河套背风处，冰凿的声音一下一下。「我」循声找过去，半个镇子已经用冰雕好了。她先不说话，凿完手里那一下才开口。
staging.en: The lee of the river bend; the chisel strikes, one, then another. Following the sound, I find half the town already carved in ice. She doesn't speak until she finishes the stroke in hand.

text.zh: 供销社的冰房子门口，连那把算盘都雕出来了，珠子一颗一颗。
text.en: Outside the ice co-op, even the abacus is carved, bead by bead.

text.zh: ……陈远。你来了。
text.en: ...Chen Yuan. You came.

text.zh: 这是……全镇？
text.en: This is... the whole town?

text.zh: 全镇都要走。我先雕。
text.en: The whole town is leaving. I carve it first.

text.zh: 你奶奶家的窗户，是六格的，对吗。
text.en: Your grandmother's windows have six panes. Right?

staging.zh: 冰灯会的夜，河套上挤满了人。冰雕的白桦岭还没点灯。她手里攥着一盒火柴，迟迟不划。周围越热闹，两人越安静。
staging.en: The ice-lantern night; the river bend packed with people. The ice Birch Ridge is still dark. She holds a box of matches and doesn't strike one. The louder the crowd, the quieter the two of them.

text.zh: 冰会化。我知道。
text.en: Ice melts. I know.

text.zh: 我只是想让它们先亮一次。
text.en: I only want them to shine once first.

text.zh: 火柴盒被她攥得有点软，她还是没划。
text.en: The matchbox has gone a little soft in her grip. She still hasn't struck one.

unsaid.en: That she leaves early on Day 8.

staging.zh: 她扛着一台录音机，递来一张纸条，然后站着等「我」看完。她开口说的第一个字卡住了，于是又递了一张。
staging.en: A tape recorder on her shoulder, she hands me a note and waits while I read. The first word she tries to say sticks, so she hands me another.

text.zh: 纸条上写：「缺一个拎磁带的。管饭。不管饱。」
text.en: The note says: "Need someone to carry tapes. Meals provided. Not enough of them."

text.zh: 陈、陈……
text.en: Ch-Ch...

text.zh: 她放弃了，又递来一张：「陈远同学。答应就点头。」
text.en: She gives up and hands over another: "Chen Yuan. Nod if yes."

text.zh: 你可以直接说的。
text.en: You can just say it.

text.zh: （举起录音机的话筒，一口气）各位听众，陈远同学已经点头了。
text.en: (Raising the recorder's mic, in one breath) Dear listeners, Chen Yuan has nodded.

staging.zh: 广播站，最后一期节目的 A 面刚放完，红灯还亮着。她手里攥着那盘没贴标签的磁带，在话筒前说得顺，转过脸来就卡住。这一幕停在她决定之前。
staging.en: The radio station; side A of the last show has just finished; the light is still on. She grips the unlabelled tape. Into the mic she's fluent; facing me she sticks. The scene stops before she decides.

text.zh: 这、这盘……
text.en: Th-this tape...

text.zh: 她把话筒从架子上拔下来，攥在手里，像攥着一根扶手。
text.en: She pulls the mic off its stand and holds it like a handrail.

text.zh: ……砚秋？
text.en: ...Yanqiu?

text.zh: 她看了一眼还亮着的红灯，又看了一眼「我」。
text.en: She looks at the red light, still on, and then at me.

unsaid.zh: 磁带里录的是什么；这盘磁带最后播不播。
unsaid.en: What's on the tape; whether it is ever aired.

staging.zh: 「我」怀里抱着一摞奶奶让捎回去的空纸箱，手腕上挂着胶带。冬禾端着一搪瓷盆冻梨过来，先损人，被问到她家的箱子就改骂天气。她不停下来，说完就走。
staging.en: I am hugging a stack of empty boxes Grandma asked me to bring home, a roll of tape on my wrist. Donghe comes by with an enamel basin of frozen pears, mocks first, and when asked about her own boxes switches to cursing the weather. She never stops walking.

text.zh: 「我」怀里抱着一摞空纸箱，是奶奶让捎回去的第十一个到第十五个。
text.en: I am hugging a stack of empty boxes, numbers eleven to fifteen of Grandma's order.

text.zh: 哟，打包呢？缠那么多圈，到了市里你拿牙咬开啊？
text.en: Packing, huh? All that tape, you planning to open it with your teeth in the city?

text.zh: 你家打包了吗？我路过你家，门口一个箱子都没有。
text.en: Have you packed? I passed your place. Not one box outside.

text.zh: 这天儿，贼冷。……昨晚零下三十四，你知道不？我家窗户上的霜结了一指厚。
text.en: This weather, though. Brutal. ...Thirty-four below last night, you know that? Frost a finger thick on our window.

text.zh: 我问的是箱子。
text.en: I asked about boxes.

text.zh: 冻梨，拿着。缓好的。
text.en: Frozen pears. Take them. They're thawed.

text.zh: 她把搪瓷盆往纸箱顶上一搁，转身走了，围巾的一头拖在地上。
text.en: She plonks the basin on top of my boxes and walks off, one end of her scarf trailing on the ground.

unsaid.en: That her family is not moving.

staging.zh: 浴池门口，棉门帘一掀就是一团白汽。砚秋抱着录音机出来，冬禾堵在台阶上。两人都对着「我」说话，谁都不看谁。三年级那件事只漏出半句，冬禾自己就停住了。
staging.en: The bathhouse door; every lift of the quilted curtain lets out a cloud of steam. Yanqiu comes out hugging the recorder; Donghe blocks the step. Both talk at me and look at each other at no point. The third-grade business slips out for half a sentence before Donghe stops herself.

text.zh: 许砚秋，你录我爸了？
text.en: Xu Yanqiu. You taped my dad?

text.zh: 录、录了。他……
text.en: Y-yes. He...

text.zh: 录啥了？你要往大喇叭里放？
text.en: Taped what? You going to put it on the loudspeaker?

text.zh: 砚秋从兜里摸出纸条和笔，笔冻得写不出水，她对着笔尖哈了两口气。
text.en: Yanqiu fishes out a slip and a pen; the ink is frozen, and she breathes on the nib twice.

text.zh: 又写！三年级你就这样，有话不说——
text.en: Writing again! You were like this in third grade, never just saying—

text.zh: 冬禾说到一半自己停住了，像踩空了一级台阶。
text.en: Donghe stops mid-sentence, like she missed a step.

text.zh: 那、那段不播。我……保证。
text.en: Th-that part won't air. I... promise.

text.zh: 你保证有啥用。
text.en: What good's your promise.

text.zh: 她一掀棉门帘进了澡堂，白汽扑了「我」一脸。
text.en: She flings the curtain aside and goes in; the steam hits me full in the face.

unsaid.zh: 录音里韩师傅说了什么；三年级那天后来怎样。
unsaid.en: What Old Han said on the tape; what happened after that day in third grade.

staging.zh: 夜里，主街尽头的长坡，路灯底下。她从仓房里拖出那辆旧冰车，铜铃铛冻哑了。她催「我」上车的口气像在吵架，翻进雪里以后反倒不说话了。
staging.en: Night, the long slope at the end of Main Street, under a streetlight. She has dragged the old ice sled out of the shed; its brass bell is frozen nearly mute. She orders me aboard like she's picking a fight, and goes quiet once we tip into the snow.

text.zh: 冰车上的铜铃铛冻得发哑，她晃了半天才响一声。
text.en: The brass bell on the sled is frozen half-mute; she shakes it a long while before it rings once.

text.zh: 上来。咋的，南方人不敢了？
text.en: Get on. What, the southerner's scared?

text.zh: 这车好些年没人坐了吧。
text.en: Nobody's ridden this in years.

text.zh: 没那么久。去年冬天我自己滑过一回。……一个人滑没意思。
text.en: Not that long. I took it down once last winter, by myself. ...No fun alone.

text.zh: 冰车冲下坡，在坡底转了半圈，把两个人一起甩进雪堆。
text.en: The sled shoots down the slope, spins half around at the bottom, and throws us both into a drift.

text.zh: 谁也别先起来啊。小时候就这规矩。
text.en: Nobody gets up first. That was the rule when we were kids.

unsaid.en: Who rides with her next winter.

staging.zh: 下午的冻河，两人一人一头拉锯，从河面上切冰块。她话少，只教怎么看冰。冷到说不出话时，两个人一起跺脚，跺到同一个拍子上。
staging.en: The frozen river in the afternoon; one at each end of the saw, cutting blocks from the ice. She says little except how to read the ice. When it gets too cold to talk, both of us stamp our feet until we fall into the same beat.

text.zh: 锯子给你，那头。顺着纹路，别横着。
text.en: Saw's yours. That end. With the grain, not across.

text.zh: 切开的冰面是青的，里面封着一串细小的气泡，像谁往水里吹了一口气。
text.en: The cut face of the ice is blue-green, a string of tiny bubbles sealed inside, as if someone had breathed into the water.

text.zh: 你怎么知道纹路往哪边走？
text.en: How do you know which way the grain runs?

text.zh: 看气泡。气泡斜的那边，是风来的地方。
text.en: Look at the bubbles. The way they slant is where the wind came from.

text.zh: 冻得说不出话了，两个人就一起跺脚，一下，两下，跺到了同一个拍子上。
text.en: Too cold to speak, we stamp our feet, one, two, until we are stamping in time.

text.zh: 阿爸说，跺脚的时候不能说话，会咬到舌头。
text.en: My father says you mustn't talk while stamping. You'll bite your tongue.

text.zh: 真的？
text.en: Really?

text.zh: 不知道。他多半是骗我的。……可我跺脚的时候，一直没说过话。
text.en: I don't know. He was probably fooling me. ...I still have never talked while stamping.

staging.zh: 供销社柜台边，奶奶在挑最后几团毛线。砚秋叫人卡在第一个字，干脆按下录音键，把话筒举到嘴边，一口气说下去。奶奶对着话筒说完告别，又顺口数落了她一句。
staging.en: By the co-op counter Grandma is picking through the last balls of yarn. Yanqiu sticks on the first word of her name, so she presses record, raises the mic, and the rest comes out in one breath. Grandma says her farewell into it, then tacks on a scolding for Yanqiu.

text.zh: 陈、陈家……
text.en: Gr-Grandma...

text.zh: 她按下录音键，把话筒举到嘴边。
text.en: She presses record and lifts the mic to her mouth.

text.zh: 陈家奶奶，请您对白桦岭说一句告别的话。
text.en: Grandma Chen, please say a word of farewell to Birch Ridge.

text.zh: 告别啥呀。我在这儿腌了五十年酸菜，缸我带走，酸菜味儿给你们留下。
text.en: Farewell, nothing. Fifty years I pickled cabbage here. I'm taking the crock; the smell I leave to you.

text.zh: 奶奶低头绕着手里那团毛线，又补了一句。
text.en: Grandma winds the yarn in her hands, eyes down, and adds one more thing.

text.zh: 还有，广播站那丫头，晚上早点睡。灯老亮着，费电。
text.en: And the girl at the broadcast room: go to bed earlier. That light's always on. Wastes power.

text.zh: （话筒还举着，一口气）收到。各位听众，以上是陈家奶奶。
text.en: (Mic still raised, in one breath) Noted. Dear listeners, that was Grandma Chen.

unsaid.zh: 她半夜在录的是哪一盘。
unsaid.en: Which tape she is recording at midnight.

commonGoal.zh: 共通线：重逢与清仓，三个人都露面；每人一个反常：韩家门口没有纸箱、乌兰草稿纸上的平面图、砚秋的纸条。
commonGoal.en: Common route: reunions and clearance sales; all three appear, each with one oddity: no boxes at the Han house, Ulan's floor plans, Yanqiu's notes.

goal.zh: 个人线·冬禾：走的人和留的人；炉子、帽子、锅炉房。
goal.en: Donghe route: those who leave and those who stay; the stove, the hat, the boiler house.

others.zh: 乌兰照样凿冰，砚秋的纸条变少了。
others.en: Ulan keeps carving; Yanqiu's notes grow fewer.

goal.zh: 个人线·乌兰：一座冰做的镇子，一次要亮的灯。
goal.en: Ulan route: a town made of ice, a light that has to shine once.

others.zh: 冬禾嘴上骂「远子天天往河套跑」，手上给你们送热水。
others.en: Donghe grumbles "Yuanzi's always at the river", then brings you hot water.

goal.zh: 个人线·砚秋：全镇的告别都录了，只有一盘不敢播。
goal.en: Yanqiu route: she has recorded the whole town's goodbyes except the one she dare not air.

others.zh: 冬禾以为砚秋在录韩家的事，见她就绕道。
others.en: Donghe thinks Yanqiu is recording her family's business and avoids her.

ensemble.zh: 群像线：最后一班车上挤满了全镇的人，三个人的事在站台上一起收尾。
ensemble.en: Ensemble route: the last train is packed with the whole town; all three threads close together on the platform.

truth.zh: 三年级那天冬禾为她把人打哭、挨了全校通报，砚秋一下午都卡在「谢」字上；放学前她把「谢谢你」写在纸条上，叠了四折，到今天也没递出去，就夹在广播站那本节目单里。冬禾一直以为砚秋嫌她粗。
truth.en: The day in third grade when Donghe punched the boy to tears for her and got reprimanded in front of the whole school, Yanqiu spent the afternoon stuck on the first sound of "thank you". Before the bell she wrote "thank you" on a slip, folded it four times, and has never handed it over; it is still tucked in the broadcast room's program sheets. Donghe has always thought Yanqiu finds her crude.

reframes.zh: 旧合影里三个人挤在同一辆冰车上
reframes.en: the old photo of the three of us squeezed onto one ice sled

truth.zh: 「开春才走」是巴特尔替女儿圆的话：乌兰怕说出走的日子，冰雕会来不及。
truth.en: "Not till spring" was Bater covering for his daughter: Ulan feared that naming the day would leave the ice town unfinished.

reframes.zh: 巴特尔在冻河上喊的那一嗓子长调
reframes.en: Bater's long-song shout across the frozen river
how she carved faster and faster

truth.zh: 砚秋录下的是韩师傅的告别。录的时候他还以为闺女开春就去市里念书，托砚秋录一段话，等闺女到了市里再寄给她：「闺女。……到了市里，别惦记炉子。……爸烧得动。」他让砚秋千万别在广播里放，砚秋答应了，所以在澡堂门口一个字也不肯说。
truth.en: What Yanqiu taped was Old Han's goodbye. When he recorded it he still believed his daughter would start at the city school in spring, and asked Yanqiu to tape a few words to post to her once she was there: "Girl. ...In the city, don't fret about the stove. ...Your dad can keep it going." He made Yanqiu swear never to air it, and she kept her word; that is why she would not say a thing outside the bathhouse.

reframes.zh: 澡堂门口谁都不肯说那段录音是什么
reframes.en: how neither of them would say what was on the tape outside the bathhouse

reframes.zh: 韩师傅那句「她答应我了」

text.zh: 小学时的冬天，三个孩子挤一辆冰车从坡上冲下去，翻在雪里，谁也不肯先起来。
text.en: A primary-school winter: three kids on one ice sled down the slope, tipping into the snow, nobody willing to get up first.

text.zh: 牧区的春天，雪化的那天，草从冰下面露出来一点绿。
text.en: Spring on the grassland: the day the snow melts, a little green shows beneath the ice.

text.zh: 小时候她在锅炉房的长条凳上写作业，炉门一开，作业本上全是红光；她爸添完煤，就用煤灰手指在她算错的题上画个圈。
text.en: As a kid she did homework on the long bench in the boiler house; whenever the firebox opened, the page went red. After stoking, her dad would ring her wrong answers with a coal-black finger.

text.zh: 小时候傍晚那趟车的汽笛一响，奶奶就在院子里喊：「孩儿啊，车过去了，回家吃饭。」
text.en: When I was small, the moment the evening train whistled, Grandma would call across the yard: "Child, the train's gone by. Home for supper."

text.zh: 第一次对着广播站的话筒，她念完整整一页稿子，一个字都没卡，自己吓了一跳。
text.en: The first time at the station mic, she read a whole page without a single stutter and startled herself.

weather.zh: 零下三十一度，晴，天蓝得发硬
weather.en: minus thirty-one, clear, a hard blue sky

bits.en: frost ferns on the train window

bits.zh: 奶奶把腌酸菜的缸也要带走
bits.en: Grandma insists on taking the pickling crock

bits.zh: 补课班的炉子烧得太旺，前排的人脸通红
bits.en: the classroom stove is too hot; the front row is red-faced

weather.en: clear, cold enough to hurt the ears

bits.zh: 浴池的水汽从门缝里冒出来，在门框上结成冰溜子
bits.en: bathhouse steam leaks out and freezes into icicles on the frame

bits.zh: 浴池最后一天，搓澡师傅不收钱
bits.en: the bathhouse's last day; the scrubber charges nothing

bits.zh: 冰灯里的蜡烛要用玻璃罩挡风
bits.en: candles in the ice lanterns need glass shades

bits.zh: 班车的排气管冒着白汽
广播站的暖气片上烤着两个冻梨
bits.en: two frozen pears thawing on the station radiator
more people on the platform than snow

coop.zh: 清仓的牌子用红纸写着，墨冻住了
coop.en: the clearance sign on red paper, the ink frozen

station.zh: 候车室的铁炉子上烤着一排棉鞋
station.en: a row of cotton shoes drying on the waiting-room stove

boiler.zh: 煤堆上落着一层雪，雪上有一串猫脚印
boiler.en: snow on the coal heap, a line of cat prints across it

street.zh: 主街两边的冰溜子有一人高
street.en: icicles along the main street as tall as a person

radio.zh: 广播站的窗户糊着报纸挡风
radio.en: the station windows papered over against the wind

river.zh: 冰车的白道子一直通到对岸
river.en: white sled tracks running all the way to the far bank

river.zh: 冰窟窿边上冻着一截去年的渔网
river.en: a scrap of last year's fishing net frozen at the edge of an ice hole

bath.zh: 门口的棉门帘冻得硬邦邦，掀开要用两只手
bath.en: the quilted door curtain frozen stiff; it takes both hands to lift

school.zh: 粉笔得先在暖气片上焐热了才写得出字
school.en: chalk has to be warmed on the radiator before it will write

any.zh: 冻梨泡在凉水里缓一宿，外面结一层冰壳
any.en: frozen pears soaking overnight, growing an ice crust

text.zh: 韩师傅高兴了添一锹煤，不高兴也添一锹，「我」开始用添煤的力度猜他的心情。
text.en: Old Han adds a shovel of coal when he's happy and when he's not; I start guessing his mood by how hard he shovels.

text.zh: 孟站长报时报到秒，「我」的手机慢了两分钟，他非要帮「我」调。
text.en: Stationmaster Meng gives the time to the second; my phone is two minutes slow, and he insists on fixing it.

text.zh: 巴特尔一喝奶茶就哼长调，哼到一半忘词，就改成锅炉房的口令。
text.en: Bater hums a long-song whenever he drinks milk tea; when he forgets the words he switches to boiler-room shift calls.

text.zh: 冬禾和砚秋见面就别扭，有话全让「我」传：「你跟她说……」「（纸条）你告诉她……」，传到后来「我」自己都分不清是谁在挤兑谁。
text.en: Donghe and Yanqiu are awkward face to face, so everything goes through me: "Tell her..." "(note) Tell her...", until I can't tell who is needling whom.

text.zh: 奶奶的酸菜缸装上爬犁又搬下来，搬下来又装上去，每次都说「这回定了」。
text.en: Grandma's pickling crock goes onto the sledge, comes off, goes back on; every time she says, "That's settled, then."

text.zh: 奶奶说「孩儿啊」的时候低头摆弄针线笸箩，说明下一句是要紧话。
text.en: When Grandma says "child" and fiddles with her sewing basket, the next sentence matters.

text.zh: 「韩家一个纸箱都没要。孩儿啊，你说这是咋回事。」
text.en: "The Hans didn't take a single box. Child, what do you make of that."

text.zh: 「许家丫头跟我约好了，最后一声汽笛归她录。正点。」
text.en: "The Xu girl and I have a deal: the last whistle is hers to record. On the dot."

text.zh: 「乌兰？开春走。开春……对，开春。」——说完喝了一大口奶茶。
text.en: "Ulan? Leaving in spring. Spring... yes, spring." Then a long gulp of milk tea.

text.zh: 「广播站的灯又亮到半夜。那丫头，录的比说的多。」
text.en: "The broadcast-room light burned past midnight again. That girl records more than she says."

text.zh: 「巴特尔家那闺女天天往河套跑，手套都磨漏了。」
text.en: "Bater's girl runs down to the river every day. She's worn through her mittens."

text.zh: 「那张空路票我还留着。这位旅客有票了……那就再想想，给谁。」
text.en: "I've still got that blank ticket. This passenger here has his own... so, I'll think on who it's for."

text.zh: 「她……开春去市里。……念书好。」
text.en: "She's... off to the city in spring. ...School's good."

habits.en: three insults, then food in your hand
pokes the stove when you hit a nerve

contradiction.zh: 对谁都说「我们家也搬」，家里一样没打包
contradiction.en: tells everyone "we're moving too", hasn't packed a thing

growth.zh: 从一个人扛，到让她爸知道
growth.en: from carrying it alone to letting her father know

style.zh: 写在供销社的旧账本上，东北话，错别字，句号用得很少
style.en: in an old co-op ledger, dialect, typos, few full stops

seesMe.en: still the Yuanzi from back then
he's leaving on that train too
the only one who knows about the transfer
I want to give him the hat

awayVoice.en: "Yuanzi, the stove's still warm. Where are you."

habits.zh: 在草稿纸背面画平面图
habits.en: draws floor plans on the backs of worksheets

contradiction.zh: 雕的是会化的东西，要的是留下来的东西
contradiction.en: carves what melts, wants what lasts

growth.zh: 从一个人凿冰，到把火柴递出去
growth.en: from carving alone to handing over the matches

style.zh: 短句，完整，像测量记录：哪一户、几格窗、冰里有没有气泡
style.en: short complete sentences, like survey notes: which house, how many panes, whether the ice has bubbles

seesMe.en: someone who can pull a sledge
he has seen the ice town
I want him to light that one

dejaVu.zh: 「陈远。你奶奶家的窗户……我好像已经问过你了。」
dejaVu.en: "Chen Yuan. Your grandmother's windows... I think I've asked you before."

quirks.zh: 对话筒字正腔圆，对人卡第一个字
quirks.en: fluent into a mic, stuck on the first word face to face

habits.zh: 紧张时把话筒拿在手里

contradiction.zh: 替全镇说告别，自己的那句不敢播
contradiction.en: broadcasts the whole town's goodbyes, can't air her own

growth.en: from notes to saying it aloud

style.zh: 广播稿格式，标点精确；页边有小字，比正文刻薄
style.en: broadcast-script format, precise punctuation; marginal notes sharper than the text

hides.zh: 最后一盘磁带录的是什么

seesMe.zh: 陈家奶奶的外孙（已播报）
我可以不用纸条对他说话
seesMe.en: I can talk to him without notes

awayVoice.zh: 「各位听众，陈远同学今天缺席。」
awayVoice.en: "Dear listeners, Chen Yuan is absent today."

habits.zh: 说要紧话前摆弄针线笸箩
habits.en: fiddles with her sewing basket before saying something important
